title: The Potential Mismatch Between Japan and the US on China
author: Terrence Matsuo
text:
Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae (right) shakes hands with U.S. President Donald Trump during their summit meeting in Tokyo, Japan, Oct. 28, 2025.
Credit: Prime Minister’s Office of Japan
As the two most powerful countries in the world today, it is incredibly important that U.S. President Donald Trump will meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington on September 24. But before that, Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae of Japan is hoping to gain a meeting with Trump during her own visit to the United States for the U.N. General Assembly. Both Trump and Takaichi are scheduled to address the General Debate in New York on September 22; as of September 17 “nothing has been decided” regarding a potential meeting, according to Takaichi. [...]
